selection: On outer-training questions only: among candidates with mean tokens and replay time <=75% of fixed8K, maximize accuracy; ties prefer fewer tokens then rule name. If none meets cost ceiling choose lowest-token candidate and mark training cost infeasible. Evaluate gain-retention separately; do not tune to outer outcomes.
validation: Leave-one-question-out, both seeds grouped. Fixed candidate family also reported separately; any full-data chosen candidate is development-only.
random_comparators: 10000 fixed-count random extension assignments matching aggregate selected extension count; report extension-matched and expected token/time-budget-matched 2K/8K mixtures. Descriptive random intervals are not selection-corrected significance tests.
bootstrap: 5000 paired question-cluster resamples of stored out-of-fold decisions; descriptive fixed-prediction intervals, does not refit selector within bootstrap.
scope: No GPU jobs. No reruns or modifications to original results. All2025 problems are development data. Only first2048 token IDs plus pinned-tokenizer decode are routing inputs; no IDs, references, final outputs or future tokens.
natural_close: If close/EOS occurs before checkpoint return observed normal early result without invoking gate; audit this condition before replay.
timing: Whole branch time measured in original fixed runs is replay estimate; exclude inference speedup claims until live validation. CPU feature timing reported separately.
